text:
My neighbor recently decided to take security seriously, erecting a bold "Beware of Dog" sign that looked like it belonged on a fortress, not a suburban lawn. The irony arrived the very next day when the postman knocked on the door. Out trotted my three-pound furball, a creature so small he could fit inside a coffee mug. The postman looked down, saw the tiny beast, and deadpanned, "Oh no, I'm so scared!"

That comment has clearly stuck in my dog’s head. He is now on a relentless mission to prove the postman wrong. He spends his days practicing his "ferocious" bark, which sounds more like a squeaky toy being stepped on, and he’s started wearing his collar backward to look more intimidating. I’m pretty sure he’s just trying to get a better angle for his glare. It’s adorable, mostly because he still gets startled by his own shadow, but he’s committed to the bit.

As for the eggplant, it is purple.
